subject: how can I have access all markers combination in "scantwo" object

messages.author: fab95f4e431516f4
messages.subject: how can I have access all markers combination in "scantwo" object
parts:
When plotting "scantwo" object it seems the plot image is a matrix of the lod score for all markers X markers.
When I use summary, each chromosome combinations is represented by a single line. My question is whether a matrix for markerXmarker lod score (considering each lod type for each model, e.g., full, additive) exists and how can I have access to these values?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how can I have access all markers combination in "scantwo" object
parts:
The output of scantwo is a list with two components: lod and map. The lod component is a matrix of positions x positions; the upper triangle contains the LOD scores for the additive model, and the lower triangle contains the LOD scores for the full model. See the help file for scantwo().

karl
